dimensions.name: Requirement Traceability
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every functional requirement traces to a specific capability, customer need, or constraint established in the Press Release, External FAQ, or Internal FAQ.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more requirements cannot be traced to prior artifacts or contradict them.

dimensions.name: Testable Acceptance Criteria
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every requirement has at least one acceptance criterion in given/when/then format with an observable outcome.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Requirements lack acceptance criteria, criteria are not in given/when/then format, or criteria are vague or untestable.

dimensions.name: Edge Case Coverage
dimensions.pass_criteria: The requirements address failure modes, empty states, boundary conditions, and relevant error scenarios.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The requirements cover only the happy path and omit relevant edge cases.

dimensions.name: Non-Functional Requirements
dimensions.pass_criteria: Performance, security, scale, and compliance requirements are present or explicitly marked [OPEN - not established in Internal FAQ].
dimensions.fail_criteria: Non-functional requirements are missing or too vague to design against.

dimensions.name: Open Item Propagation
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every relevant [OPEN] and [BLOCKER] item from the External and Internal FAQs is surfaced explicitly in requirements.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Open or blocker items are absent or silently resolved with invented assumptions.
